verses.text: Yuj chi', ex xajanab'il wu'uj, haton juntzanh tik yalnakkan Dios t'ayonh. Yuj chi' ko wach' aktejekkan masanil juntzanh tz'ak'an juwokel ko niwanil yet' ko pensar t'a yichanh Dios. Kak'ek wal kip ko wach' ak'anoch ko pensar t'a Dios, yujto te ay yelk'och t'ayonh.
Hak'ek och he k'o'ol t'ayonh. Malaj junok ex b'aj ochnak ko mul. Malaj junok ex ko junakel he pensar. Malaj pax junok ex ko k'exanh tiejnak ex.

Manh yujok wak'anoch junok tas t'a eyib'anh swalanb'at juntzanh tik t'ayex. Yujto toxo ix wal t'ayex to te na'an ex ku'uj. Yuj chi', wach'chom pitzan onh, mato tzonh chami, palta junnhej kaj heyet'ok.
Tzex wak'och yipok in k'o'ol, tzex walan wach'il. Wach'chom niwan ya'elal tz'ak'jioch t'a kib'anh, palta eyu'uj sniwanaj in k'o'ol swab'i. Tzin tzalaj wal eyu'uj.
Yiktax ix onh jawi t'a Macedonia tik, maxtzak yal kik'an jab'ok kip, yujto a juntzanh ya'elal tik oyanoch t'a ko patik kichanh. Anhej owal tz'ak'jioch t'a kib'anh. Xiwelalnhej kaji.
Palta ha Dios tz'ak'an sniwanil sk'o'ol jantak mach ayoch t'a skusk'olal. Ha ix ak'an sniwanil ko k'o'ol, yujto ix ja winhaj Tito t'a tik.

Manh yujoknhej to ix ja winhaj Tito chi' ix ak'ji sniwanil in k'o'ol, palta tzonh tzalaj pax eyu'uj, yujto ix eyak' sniwanil sk'o'ol winh ayik ix ek' winh t'ayex. Ix yalan winh t'ayonh to he gana tzin he yila'. Ix yalanpax winh to tzex kus wal yuj jun ix uji t'a he kal chi'. Ix yalanpax winh to tzin he nakoti. Yuj chi' ix wach' ja in tzalajk'olal eyu'uj.
Wach'chom te kusnak ex yuj jun carta in tz'ib'ejnakb'at t'ayex, palta maxtzak in kus yuj tiknaik. Wach'chom t'a sb'ab'elal kusnak in yuj jun carta chi', yujto wab'nak to kusnak ex jaye' k'uhal yuj.

Haxo tiknaik, tzin tzalaji manh yujok to kusnak ex yuj, palta tzin tzalaj tiknaik, yujto yuj jun he kusk'olal chi' ix he na he b'a. Ix ex kus icha wal t'a snib'ej Dios, yuj chi' manh jab'ok ix juwiel he pensar wu'uj.

Tato tzonh kus icha wal snib'ej Dios, yuj jun ko kusk'olal chi' sko na ko b'a yik tzonh kolchaji. Tato icha chi', max onh te kuslaj yuj. Palta ay junxo makan kusk'olal. Ha jun chi', yik yol yib'anhk'inal tik yaji. Ha heb' skus icha chi', tonhej sb'atkan heb' t'a chamel t'a junelnhej yuj.

Palta a exxo tik, ochnak he kusk'olal icha snib'ej Dios. Yuj chi' naekkoti tas ajnak ex yuj. Ochnak ex wal t'a ilk'olal sik'lab'il. E sayannak modo tas tz'aj he kolan he b'a. Kotnak eyowal yuj jun chukal ujinak t'a he kal chi', xiwnak ex pax yuj. E nib'ejnak wal in he k'umej. E nanak eyak'b'at t'a yib'anh jun winh ochnak smul chi'. Icha chi' eyutejnak he ch'oxani to manhxo ex lokanok t'a jun chukal chi'.

Ha jun in carta chi', manh yujok jun winh ochnak smul chi' in tz'ib'ejnakb'ati. Manh yujok pax jun mach yab'nak sya'il yuj jun chukal chi'. Palta in tz'ib'ejnakb'at t'ayex yik snachajel eyu'uj to ha t'a yichanh Dios, te xajan onh eyu'uj.

Yuj chi' ix ak'ji sniwanil ko k'o'ol. Manhoknhej ix ak'ji sniwanil ko k'o'ol. Ix wach' ja pax ko tzalajk'olal ayik ix yalan winhaj Tito to ix te tzalaj winh heyet'ok, yujto ix wach' ja sniwanil sk'o'ol winh eyu'uj he masanil.

Ha t'a yalanh, ix walel he wach'il t'a winhaj Tito tik. Haxo tiknaik, max in k'ixwi, yujto walnak jun chi'. Masanil tas kalnak t'ayex, te yel. Hanhejtona', ayik skalan he wach'il t'a winhaj Tito tik, te yel juntzanh skal chi'.

Ha winh tik, te xajan exxo pax yuj winh tiknaik, yujto snakot winh tas eyutejnak he k'anab'ajan tas yalnak winh t'ayex. Sna'anpaxkot winh to emnakil eyutejnak he b'a he cha'an winh, xiwk'olal eyutejnak he b'a t'a winh.
Tzin tzalaj tiknaik, yujto syal ex wak'anoch yipok in k'o'ol.
